mapper.sql: id,org_id orgId,name,pinyin_name pinyinName,face_url faceUrl,wo_guid woGuid,mobile,Mobile_owner mobileOwner,medical_number medicalNumber,gender,age,birthday,origin_type originType,origin_id originId,remarks, inservice,crt_id crtId,crt_name crtName,crt_time crtTime,upt_id uptId,upd_name updName,upd_time updTime,source_id sourceId,person_id personId
mapper.select: select from patient_base_info where name = #{form.name} and mobile = #{form.mobile}

select pbi.face_url faceUrl,pbi.name name,pbi.gender gender,pbi.age age,pbi.mobile mobile, pbi.medical_number medicalNumber,pmi.member_type_id memberTypeId, cast(SUM(pmi.principal_amount+pmi.bonus_amount) as decimal(15,2)) memberCardMoneySum, cast(SUM(ppi.prepayment_principal+ppi.prepayment_bonus)as decimal(15,2)) prepaymentsMoneySum from patient_base_info pbi left join patient_prepayments_info ppi on pbi.id = ppi.patient_id left join patient_member_info pmi on pbi.id = pmi.patient_id where pbi.id = #{id}
select id,origin_id patientId,name,gender,mobile,crt_time crtTime from patient_base_info where source_id = #{form.patientId} and origin_type = 2 order by crtTime desc
select from patient_base_info where CONCAT(IFNULL(name,''), IFNULL(medical_number,''),IFNULL(pinyin_name,''),IFNULL(mobile,'')) like CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{form.condition}),'%')
select from patient_base_info where name = #{form.name} and mobile = #{form.mobile} and org_id = #{form.orgId}

select pbi.id, pbi.org_id as orgId, pbi.`name`, pbi.pinyin_name as pinyinName, pbi.mobile, pbi.medical_number as medicalNumber, pbi.gender, pbi.age, pbi.birthday, pbi.remarks, pei.patient_kind as patientKind, pei.useful_phone as usefulPhone, pei.identity, pei.profession, pei.heredity, pei.other_health as otherHealth, pmi.member_type_id as memberTypeId from patient_base_info pbi left join patient_exp_info pei on pbi.id = pei.patient_id left join patient_member_info pmi on pbi.id = pmi.patient_id where pbi.id = #{id}
SELECT IFNULL( MAX( SUBSTR( medical_number, 10, 6 )), '000000' ) AS maxNum FROM patient_base_info WHERE org_id = #{orgId}
mapper.update: update patient_base_info set face_url = #{form.faceUrl} where id = #{form.id}
